title.zh: Laser退火：能量更局部，也更依赖光学条件
title.en: Laser annealing: more localized energy, greater dependence on optical conditions

subtitle.zh: 波长、扫描、吸收率和熔融模式共同控制
subtitle.en: Wavelength, scanning, absorptivity and melting mode jointly control the process

body.zh: 激光可实现局部或极浅层快速加热，但材料反射率、图形密度与扫描重叠会直接改变温度分布。
body.en: Laser enables rapid local or very shallow heating, but reflectivity, pattern density and scan overlap directly change the temperature distribution.

body.zh: 扫描重叠（Overlap）对温度均匀性的影响
body.en: Effect of scan overlap on temperature uniformity

body.zh: 重叠不足拼接缝隙，热斑间断
body.en: Insufficient overlap Stitching gaps and discontinuous hot spots

body.zh: 理想重叠温度分布更均匀
body.en: Ideal overlap More uniform temperature distribution

body.zh: 重叠过多中心过热，效率下降
body.en: Excessive overlap Center overheating and lower efficiency

body.zh: 两类热模式（并非绝对优劣）
非熔融 / Sub-melt表面升温，但保持固相无熔化，保持固相
body.en: Sub-melt The surface heats while remaining solid No melting; solid phase retained

body.zh: 熔融/Melt极表层短暂熔化，随后再结晶再结晶，可能改变相/缺陷
body.en: Melt The extreme surface melts briefly, then recrystallizes Recrystallization May change phases / defects
Check the film stack’s Optical properties

body.zh: 波长与吸收率吸收率随波长、材料与膜厚而变
body.en: Wavelength and absorptivity Absorptivity varies with wavelength, Material and film thickness

body.zh: Fluence/ 功率能量决定升温与是否熔融（模式切换）
body.en: Fluence / power Energy determines heating and Whether melting occurs (mode switching)

body.zh: Spot Size光斑大小影响能量密度与热影响体积
body.en: Spot Size Spot size affects energy density And the thermally affected volume

body.zh: 扫描速度 / Overlap与熔融模式影响温度分布、加热时间与熔融概率
body.en: Scan speed / Overlap And melting mode Affects temperature distribution, heating time And the probability of melting

body.zh: 局部加热，周边热影响较小
body.en: Local heating with A smaller surrounding thermal impact

body.zh: 图形密度、反射率、扫描拼接与表面形貌更敏感
body.en: Greater sensitivity to pattern density, reflectivity, Scan stitching and surface morphology

body.zh: 风险与失效模式（需监控）
量测反馈：Rs Map · Raman / XRD · TEM · SIMS · 表面形貌
body.en: Metrology feedback: Rs Map · Raman / XRD · TEM · SIMS · surface morphology

body.zh: 闭环优化：波长、功率、光斑与扫描窗口
body.en: Closed-loop optimization: Wavelength, power, Spot and scanning window

body.zh: 下游影响（需评估与验证）
边界：Laser Anneal包含连续波、扫描式和脉冲式等多种模式，不存在统一的“激光退火Recipe”
body.en: Boundary: Laser Anneal includes continuous-wave, scanned and pulsed modes; there is no universal “laser-annealing Recipe”
